verdict.rationale: Docs say you can connect your own repository, or several, so coding agents get codebase context. Delivery is GitHub-backed: branch rules, required reviews and Actions work out of the box, and permissions follow GitHub merge authority. Agent-produced pull requests are tracked in Review Hub for engineers to merge. Missing for 10: an explicit documented GitHub connection/auth flow (e.g. GitHub App install and scopes), explicit statement that agents themselves open the PRs rather than this being implied, and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing/docs claims.
